items.html:
(to the question) With the rod, the gourd is beaten
It is a parable concerning the Sefira of Netzah of ZA, which is truly counted as part of the main body of ZA, over which the externals have no hold; and yet a hold was made in it for the externals because of the interchanging of the lights that occurred in AB of AK, where the light of Hochma ascended and was clothed in Keter, and the light of Bina in the vessel of Hochma, and so forth, until the light of Hod was clothed in the vessel of Netzah, and so forth. And through this interchange, in which the light of Hod, which is the phase of Malchut, was clothed in the vessel of Netzah, a hold was made for the externals also in the vessel of Netzah. See below, answer 107. (Part 1, Page 130, Item 9).
